headline: French Actor Gérard Depardieu Drops Appeal Over Sexual Assault Case
seoTitle: Gérard Depardieu Drops Sexual Assault Appeal
metaDescription: Actor Gérard Depardieu has withdrawn his appeal regarding a 2025 conviction for sexual assault, issuing a formal apology to the two victims involved.
aiSummaryBullets: Actor Gérard Depardieu formally withdrew his appeal against a 2025 sexual assault conviction.
Depardieu issued a written statement acknowledging the court's verdict and apologizing to the two victims.
The legal matter stems from incidents that occurred on a film set in 2021 during the production of Les Volets Verts.
aiContextParagraph: French actor Gérard Depardieu, 77, has officially ended his legal challenge against a 2025 conviction for the sexual assault of two women. The incidents reportedly took place in 2021 while filming the movie 'Les Volets Verts'. In a public statement released on Monday, Depardieu accepted the court's decision, stating that he heard and accepted the guilty verdict. This development marks the first time the actor has offered an apology to those involved in the case. Beyond this specific conviction, the actor remains involved in further legal proceedings. He is currently facing a separate indictment related to a rape complaint, with a court decision for that case expected on November 26. These events have drawn significant media coverage across France and international news outlets, highlighting the conclusion of a high-profile legal dispute involving a prominent cultural figure.
